units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 17:49">Targ. I Sam. XVII, 49</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 10:19">Targ. Y. Ex. X, 19</cite> <he>אקלע</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="I00525"><he>טלק</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to be thrown; to happen to come, happen to fall (on a certain day).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 110a">Ḥull. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ לסורא וכ׳</he> happened to come to Sura on the eve of &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 110a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>אִיקְלְעוּ לבי וכ׳</he> happened to come to the house (were the guests) of &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 46b:5">Pes. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>הואיל ומִיקְלְעֵי וכ׳</he> since guests may happen to come to him.
<cite ref="Nedarim 8a:7">Ned. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דמִקְלְעֵי ליה וכ׳</he> until ten persons … pass by him.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 20a:4">R. Hash. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>דא׳ יום שלשים וכ׳</he> if the thirtieth day happens to fall on a Sabbath.
<cite ref="Berakhot 53b:12">Ber. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>אי מִקְּלַע לי ממילא</he> if I happen to get it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 117b:10">Sabb. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>כי מיקלע להו וכ׳</he> if they by chance had bread that had been used for an ʿErub (<cite ref="P00680"><he>עֵירוּב</he></cite>); a. fr.
